page.title: [XX-Import Transactions-XX]
page.subtitle: [XX-Import transactions from QIF/QMTF, OFX/QFX, or CSV files, or bring across a whole Microsoft Money (.mny) or KMyMoney (.kmy, .xml) file-XX]

upload.heading: [XX-Upload Transaction Files-XX]
upload.instructions:
[XX-Select one or more files to import. Supported formats: QIF/QMTF, OFX/QFX, CSV, Microsoft Money (.mny), and KMyMoney (.kmy, .xml).
You can select multiple files of the same type for bulk import. Import Microsoft Money and KMyMoney files one at a time — a .mny or .kmy file holds a whole profile.
An .xml file is opened as a KMyMoney file or an OFX statement, whichever its contents say.-XX]
upload.unsupportedDrop: [XX-These files cannot be imported: {names}. Use QIF/QMTF, OFX, QFX, CSV, Microsoft Money (.mny), or KMyMoney (.kmy, .xml) files.-XX]
upload.acceptedFormats: [XX-QIF/QMTF, OFX, QFX, CSV, Microsoft Money (.mny), or KMyMoney (.kmy, .xml)-XX]
upload.mnyFailedHeading: [XX-That Microsoft Money file could not be opened-XX]
upload.kmyFailedHeading: [XX-That KMyMoney file could not be opened-XX]
upload.requestFailed: [XX-The server did not answer in time, or the connection dropped, so the file was not checked. This does not mean the file is damaged. Wait a moment and choose it again.-XX]

docsNotice.title: [XX-Before you import-XX]
docsNotice.body: [XX-Read the <money>Importing from Microsoft Money</money> or <quicken>Importing from Quicken</quicken> section of the documentation before importing anything. OFX/QFX and QIF files each have their own quirks — see <ofx>Importing OFX/QFX Files</ofx> and <qif>Importing Quicken QIF Files</qif>. KMyMoney files have their own guide: <kmymoney>Importing from KMyMoney</kmymoney>.-XX]

selectAccount.descriptionBulk: [XX-Verify or change the destination account for each file. Files have been automatically matched based on filename.-XX]
selectAccount.investmentFileNotice: [XX-This file contains investment transactions. Only brokerage accounts are shown.-XX]

csvMapping.heading: [XX-CSV Column Mapping-XX]
csvMapping.description: [XX-Map your CSV columns to transaction fields. Preview the data below and configure the mapping.-XX]
csvMapping.columnMappingHelp: [XX-Map each CSV column to a transaction field. Date, Amount type and either Amount or Debit/Credit are required; the rest are optional.-XX]
csvMapping.signFieldHelp: [XX-How the amount's sign is read: As-is treats a positive number as a deposit, Reverse treats it as a withdrawal (use this for credit card statements where charges are positive), and a transaction type column decides direction from its own values instead of the sign.-XX]
csvMapping.typeColumnDescription: [XX-Select the column that indicates income, expense, or transfer per row.-XX]
csvMapping.transferAccountColumnDesc: [XX-Column containing the transfer destination account name. Defaults to the Category column if not set.-XX]
csvMapping.tagsHelp: [XX-Multiple tags are auto-split on the detected separator (|, ;, or ,). Dashes and slashes are preserved as part of tag names.-XX]
csvMapping.reconciliationStatusHelp: [XX-Values like "cleared", "reconciled", "posted", "void", "*", or "X" are mapped automatically. Unknown values default to Unreconciled.-XX]
csvMapping.validationDebitCreditRequired: [XX-Both debit and credit columns are required-XX]
csvMapping.validationActionRequired: [XX-Action column is required for investment files-XX]
csvMapping.validationSecurityRequired: [XX-Security column is required for investment files-XX]
csvMapping.investmentModeHint: [XX-Rows are classified by the action column. Unmatched action values are imported as cash deposits or withdrawals on the linked cash account.-XX]
csvMapping.actionValuesUnmatched: [XX-Not matched (imported as cash by amount sign): {values}-XX]
csvMapping.actionKeywordsDescription: [XX-Comma-separated values matched exactly (case-insensitive) against the action column. A filled-in list replaces the defaults shown as placeholder for that action.-XX]

transferRules.title: [XX-Transfer Detection Rules-XX]
transferRules.description: [XX-Define patterns to identify transactions that are transfers between accounts. Matching is case-insensitive and uses "contains" logic.-XX]

kmyWarnings.multipleStockSplits: [XX-{count, plural, one {# investment transaction} other {# investment transactions}} moved more than one security; the extra securities were imported as added or removed shares, without cost.-XX]
kmyWarnings.splitActionInMultiSplit: [XX-{count, plural, one {# stock split was} other {# stock splits were}} recorded inside another transaction; as in KMyMoney, they were imported as added or removed shares.-XX]
kmyWarnings.tradeFundedFromEquity: [XX-{count, plural, one {# trade was} other {# trades were}} paid from an equity account; the shares and their cost were imported, without a cash movement.-XX]
kmyWarnings.sharesAddedWithoutCost: [XX-{count, plural, one {# share addition has} other {# share additions have}} no cost in KMyMoney, so gains on selling those shares cannot be calculated. Edit them in Monize to add the cost if you know it.-XX]
kmyWarnings.stockSplitRatioRounded: [XX-{count, plural, one {# stock split ratio has} other {# stock split ratios have}} more decimal places than Monize stores; share counts after {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} may differ from KMyMoney by a tiny fraction.-XX]
kmyWarnings.stockSplitRoundingDiffers: [XX-{count, plural, one {# stock split left} other {# stock splits left}} a fraction of a share that KMyMoney rounded away and Monize keeps. Check the holding against your statement.-XX]
kmyWarnings.stockSplitRatioSuspicious: [XX-{count, plural, one {# stock split looks} other {# stock splits look}} inverted compared with the prices around them. Check the split ratio against your statement.-XX]
kmyWarnings.priceCurrencyMismatch: [XX-{count, plural, one {# price was} other {# prices were}} recorded in a currency other than the security's and {count, plural, one {was} other {were}} not imported.-XX]
kmyWarnings.unusedCurrencyRatesSkipped: [XX-{count, plural, one {# exchange rate is} other {# exchange rates are}} for currencies none of your accounts or securities use and {count, plural, one {was} other {were}} not imported.-XX]
kmyWarnings.crossCurrencyTradeUnconverted: [XX-{count, plural, one {# trade was} other {# trades were}} recorded in a currency other than the security's and the file has no rate to convert {count, plural, one {it} other {them}}; {count, plural, one {its amount was} other {their amounts were}} imported unconverted. Check the price of each.-XX]
kmyWarnings.crossCurrencyTransferRateMissing: [XX-{count, plural, one {# transfer between accounts in different currencies has} other {# transfers between accounts in different currencies have}} no exchange rate, neither in {count, plural, one {its} other {their}} amounts nor in the file's prices, and {count, plural, one {was} other {were}} imported without one. Open the receiving side of each and enter the rate.-XX]
kmyWarnings.tradeAmountsDiffer: [XX-{count, plural, one {# trade was} other {# trades were}} mapped with a total and commission that {count, plural, one {does} other {do}} not add up to the share value the file records. Do not import until this is explained.-XX]
kmyWarnings.investmentTransactionUnclassified: [XX-{count, plural, one {# transaction with a share movement fits} other {# transactions with a share movement fit}} no investment activity. {count, plural, one {Its} other {Their}} cash and categories were imported as a split transaction and the shares as a purchase or sale at the value the file records. Check each.-XX]
kmyWarnings.sameAccountTransferUnlinked: [XX-{count, plural, one {# transaction moves} other {# transactions move}} money from an account to itself. Each side was imported as its own entry rather than as a transfer.-XX]
kmyWarnings.reconciliationHistoryNotImported: [XX-{count, plural, one {# account has} other {# accounts have}} a reconciliation history in KMyMoney. Each entry keeps its reconciled state and date, but the statement dates and balances were not imported.-XX]
kmyWarnings.securityTransferInferred: [XX-{count, plural, one {# pair} other {# pairs}} of a removal and an addition of the same shares on the same day {count, plural, one {was} other {were}} imported as a transfer between brokerage accounts, carrying the cost. Check that each was a transfer and not a sale and a gift.-XX]
kmyWarnings.sharesRounded: [XX-{count, plural, one {# share count has} other {# share counts have}} more than eight decimal places and {count, plural, one {was} other {were}} rounded to eight.-XX]
kmyWarnings.duplicateSecuritySymbol: [XX-{count, plural, one {# security shares} other {# securities share}} a symbol with another; the later ones were renamed so they stay separate.-XX]
kmyWarnings.generatedSecuritySymbol: [XX-{count, plural, one {# security has} other {# securities have}} no symbol in KMyMoney, so a placeholder was generated and price updates left off.-XX]
kmyWarnings.loanInterestRateNotImported: [XX-{count, plural, one {# loan has} other {# loans have}} an interest rate in KMyMoney that was not imported. Enter it on the loan account in Monize.-XX]
kmyWarnings.loanTermsNotImported: [XX-{count, plural, one {# loan has} other {# loans have}} a term or original amount in KMyMoney that could not be read, so it was not imported.-XX]
kmyWarnings.loanInterestCategoryUnclear: [XX-{count, plural, one {# loan payment included} other {# loan payments included}} multiple non-principal categories, so the loan's interest category was left unset. Check whether the payment includes escrow and set the interest category after import.-XX]
kmyWarnings.loanScheduleSimplified: [XX-{count, plural, one {# scheduled loan payment splits} other {# scheduled loan payments split}} each payment into principal and interest when it is entered; {count, plural, one {it was} other {they were}} imported as one transfer of the payment amount.-XX]
kmyWarnings.investmentScheduleNotImported: [XX-{count, plural, one {# scheduled investment transaction was} other {# scheduled investment transactions were}} not imported.-XX]
kmyWarnings.unusableBill: [XX-{count, plural, one {# scheduled transaction had} other {# scheduled transactions had}} no account, no usable date or an unrecognized recurrence, and {count, plural, one {was} other {were}} skipped.-XX]
kmyWarnings.billFrequencyApproximated: [XX-{count, plural, one {# scheduled transaction repeats} other {# scheduled transactions repeat}} at an interval Monize cannot express exactly, so the closest shorter one was used.-XX]
kmyWarnings.scheduleAutoEnterNotImported: [XX-{count, plural, one {# scheduled transaction is} other {# scheduled transactions are}} entered automatically in KMyMoney; in Bills & Deposits {count, plural, one {it waits} other {they wait}} for you to post {count, plural, one {it} other {them}}.-XX]
kmyWarnings.scheduleWeekendRuleDropped: [XX-{count, plural, one {# scheduled transaction moves its} other {# scheduled transactions move their}} due date off weekends in KMyMoney; Monize keeps the date as scheduled.-XX]
kmyWarnings.scheduleOverdue: [XX-{count, plural, one {# scheduled transaction is} other {# scheduled transactions are}} overdue in KMyMoney and {count, plural, one {arrives} other {arrive}} overdue in Bills & Deposits. Post or skip the missed occurrences.-XX]
kmyWarnings.costCentersNotImported: [XX-{count, plural, one {# split has} other {# splits have}} a cost center; Monize has no cost centers, so they were not imported.-XX]
kmyWarnings.budgetsNotImported: [XX-{count, plural, one {# budget was} other {# budgets were}} not imported. Monize creates budgets from your history instead.-XX]
kmyWarnings.reportsNotImported: [XX-{count, plural, one {# saved report was} other {# saved reports were}} not imported.-XX]
kmyWarnings.onlineJobsNotImported: [XX-{count, plural, one {# online transfer order was} other {# online transfer orders were}} not imported.-XX]
kmyWarnings.onlineBankingNotImported: [XX-{count, plural, one {# account has} other {# accounts have}} online banking settings in KMyMoney; {count, plural, one {it was} other {they were}} not read, and you can set up bank sync in Monize.-XX]
kmyWarnings.accountNumbersNotImported: [XX-{count, plural, one {# account has} other {# accounts have}} an account number or IBAN, which was not imported.-XX]
kmyWarnings.payeeDetailsNotImported: [XX-{count, plural, one {# payee has} other {# payees have}} details Monize has no place for (a reference number, bank account identifiers, a link pattern), or contact details Monize could not read; those details were not imported.-XX]
kmyWarnings.payeeMatchingDisabled: [XX-{count, plural, one {# payee has} other {# payees have}} matching turned off in KMyMoney. Monize has no such setting: a later import or bank sync whose payee is exactly {count, plural, one {its name} other {one of these names}} still links to the payee.-XX]
kmyWarnings.payeeMatchKeyNotImported: [XX-{count, plural, one {# payee matching rule uses} other {# payee matching rules use}} a pattern Monize cannot reproduce exactly and {count, plural, one {was} other {were}} not imported. Add an alias to the payee in Monize if you still want one.-XX]
kmyWarnings.payeeMatchCaseWidened: [XX-{count, plural, one {# payee matching rule is} other {# payee matching rules are}} case-sensitive in KMyMoney. Monize aliases ignore case, so {count, plural, one {it also matches} other {these also match}} the same name in other capitals.-XX]
kmyWarnings.payeeMatchKeyConflict: [XX-{count, plural, one {# payee matching rule clashes} other {# payee matching rules clash}} with an alias or the name of another payee, which Monize does not allow, and {count, plural, one {was} other {were}} not imported.-XX]
kmyWarnings.payeeMatchKeyOverlap: [XX-{count, plural, one {# payee alias can} other {# payee aliases can}} match the same payee name as an alias of another payee. KMyMoney picks the payee with the longer match; Monize may pick either. Check {count, plural, one {this alias} other {these aliases}} in Monize.-XX]
kmyWarnings.payeeDefaultCategoryNotImported: [XX-{count, plural, one {# payee has} other {# payees have}} a default category Monize cannot use (an account rather than a category, one missing from the file, or a different one from another payee of the same name), so {count, plural, one {it was} other {they were}} imported without it.-XX]
kmyWarnings.payeeDetailsKept: [XX-{count, plural, one {# payee already existed} other {# payees already existed}} in Monize with {count, plural, one {its} other {their}} own default category or contact details, which were kept; the KMyMoney values were not used.-XX]
kmyWarnings.originalNameCut: [XX-{count, plural, one {# name was} other {# names were}} too long for Monize and too long to keep whole in the payee's notes or the account's description, which hold at most 500 characters; only the start of the name was kept there.-XX]
kmyWarnings.unparsableNumber: [XX-{count, plural, one {# number} other {# numbers}} in the file could not be read and {count, plural, one {was} other {were}} taken as zero.-XX]
kmyWarnings.autoCalcInPostedSplit: [XX-{count, plural, one {# posted transaction carried} other {# posted transactions carried}} a placeholder amount meant only for scheduled transactions; it was taken as zero.-XX]
kmyWarnings.mappedBalanceDiffers: [XX-{count, plural, one {# account would end} other {# accounts would end}} with a balance that differs from the one computed from the file. Do not import until this is explained.-XX]
kmyWarnings.holdingsReplayDiffers: [XX-{count, plural, one {# holding would end} other {# holdings would end}} with a share count that differs from the one computed from the file.-XX]
kmyWarnings.balanceMismatch: [XX-{count, plural, one {# account ended} other {# accounts ended}} with a balance that differs from the one computed from the KMyMoney file.-XX]
kmyWarnings.holdingsMismatch: [XX-{count, plural, one {# holding does} other {# holdings do}} not match the shares computed from your KMyMoney file.-XX]
